title: Monét X Change and Trinity the Tuck dual crowning
summary: In the All Stars 4 finale (AS-S04-E10), Monét X Change and Trinity the Tuck (filed as trinity-taylor) lip-synced to Christina Aguilera's "Fighter" and were both crowned winners — the first dual crowning in Drag Race history — splitting the Hall of Fame induction and $100,000 prize.

title: All Stars 4 LaLaPaRUza
summary: On AS-S04-E06, eliminated queens returned for a LaLaPaRUza smackdown against the remaining cast (Manila Luzon and Monét X Change were immune). Pairings: Jasmine vs Trinity ("Peanut Butter"), Farrah vs Valentina ("Kitty Girl"), Gia vs Naomi ("Adrenaline"), Latrice vs Monique ("Sissy That Walk" double shantay). Latrice Royale returned; Jasmine, Farrah, and Gia stayed out.

title: Roast in Peace: elimination suspended
summary: After Manila Luzon and Monét X Change both won the AS-S04-E05 lip sync to Aretha Franklin's "Jump to It", RuPaul suspended elimination for the week — no one went home.
